get.description: Answers 200 while the process serves requests. Makes no external calls.

Checks the database and that the data directory is writable (it writes and removes a small file, so it is limited to 300 requests per minute per client address). Makes no external calls (TMDB, gateway, TorBox).

200.description: Database and data directory are usable.

503.description: The server or an upstream service is not available right now.

get.description: Text exposition format. Label values are route templates, status codes and short fixed codes; never ids, secrets or hosts.
Events: `heartbeat`, `log`, `health`, `session` and download notifications. Each frame is `event: <name>` plus a JSON `data:` line.
